faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.whatA: A marketplace of presets, IRs and captures for pedalboards, where musicians sell and buy.
faq.siteQ: Do I need my own website?
faq.siteA: No. You get a ready-made store inside Amplifica.
faq.costQ: How much does it cost to sell?
faq.costA: There is no monthly fee. The commission is {percent}% per sale, plus the payment processing fee.
faq.payoutA: Your balance is available to withdraw {days} days after each sale.
faq.deliveryQ: How does the buyer get the preset?
faq.deliveryA: By download, in My purchases, right after payment.
faq.followersQ: Do I need a lot of followers?
faq.followersA: No. You can create your store and publish even without an audience.
faq.ownQ: Can I sell presets I already made?
faq.ownA: Yes, as long as they are your own work and you have the rights to sell them.
faq.kindsA: Presets, IRs, captures, MIDI patches and bundles.
